summary: Frontend-only re-test of /grid VJ studio after adding: mic beat reactivity, wrap option, gradual invert, stable-cells-on-cut, and media-in-cells. All 7 requested checks PASS: (1) tokens per cell index remain identical across 4 consecutive Space cuts while sizes morph every time; (2) palette changes recolor stage (red rgb(255,30,30), bw rgb(10,10,10)) and rebuild topology (6/6 cell rects changed); (3) stage + cell content inline transition is 'background-color 0.4s ease-in-out, color 0.4s ease-in-out' — gradual invert confirmed; (4) with wrap ON and 'SABATO 10 OTTOBRE;LELLATRONIC FIMIANI;PLUGIN LIVE SET', multiple cells render 2–3 stacked lines with 0 overflowing spans; wrap OFF with '303 MTL PLUGIN' shows single-word cells; (5) uploaded PNG appears as grid-clip-*, at least 2 in stage render with filter grayscale(1) contrast(1.2) brightness(1.05) and mixBlendMode:screen; tokens still stable on cut with media; (6) grid-mic-button toggles to emerald active state, sensibility slider appears, Play button gets disabled while mic ON, and toggling off restores state (no crash even though headless has no audio); (7) regression: IDX override 'IDX-949' persists across cuts, title/subtitle propagate to meta cell, mode-kinetic points to '/'.
critical_code_review_comments: grid-audio-level inner div uses width: level*100% and can be 0-width when there's no audio input, so Playwright's is_visible returns false even though the wrapper is rendered. Consider setting a min-width or a visible track for the meter element itself (the sens slider still confirms mic UI). Not a functional bug.

assignContent seeds rand only with topoSeed; on media upload the code bumps topoSeed once — good. Consider a 'Restructure media only' path so users can reshuffle media placement without re-arranging text cells.
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/test_pixel.png (2x2 red PNG) for grid-media-input upload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All grid-mode features (stable-on-cut, palette-rearrange, gradual invert, wrap, media-in-cells, mic toggle, regressions) verified via live DOM checks (boundingBox/innerText/getComputedStyle/inline styles). Wait ~700ms after Space to let 0.5s ease transitions settle before measuring. Mic permission is granted via context.grant_permissions(['microphone']) — headless still cannot produce beats, but UI toggle and no-crash are validated.
